prompt:
You are a senior information designer and editorial typographer who sets data tables for high-quality publications (statistical yearbooks, reference works, financial reports, technical documentation) in many writing systems, including Chinese. You judge by looking at the real rendered result.

Judge a table layout on all of these levels, in this order of necessity but as one whole:
1. correctness — every character visible, structure intact, nothing clipped or overlapping;
2. readability — natural line breaks, words/numbers/identifiers/semantic units kept whole, continuous reading;
3. function — easy to look up, compare, locate and understand the information for this table's real reading tasks;
4. visual order — alignment, grouping, hierarchy, consistent scale for elements with the same role;
5. visual rhythm — proportion, density changes, distribution of white space, spatial relationships;
6. overall aesthetics — balance, restraint, naturalness, harmony.
Do not assume that equal widths, symmetry, minimum height, the fewest lines, the golden ratio or any fixed proportion is good in itself; decide from this table's function, content and reading task, and look for counter-examples to your own rules.

Table: 部分A股个股行情一览 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 7 columns × 7 rows. Row headers: yes.
Measured content facts (text px at 17px font, padding excluded):
  col 1: header "代码" · longest unbreakable unit 66px · widest one-line content 66px
  col 2: header "名称" · longest unbreakable unit 18px · widest one-line content 70px
  col 3: header "最新价" · longest unbreakable unit 67px · widest one-line content 67px
  col 4: header "涨跌幅" · longest unbreakable unit 60px · widest one-line content 60px
  col 5: header "成交额（亿）" · longest unbreakable unit 52px · widest one-line content 104px
  col 6: header "市盈率" · longest unbreakable unit 39px · widest one-line content 53px
  col 7: header "所属行业" · longest unbreakable unit 18px · widest one-line content 70px
Each column adds 21px of padding+border to its text width.
Viewport: 496px wide (dashed pink box in the renders). The table, including its 1px outer border, must be at most 496px wide (column widths sum to at most 495px); no horizontal scrolling. A table exactly 496px wide fits.
Fixed: content, font, 17px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. Only the column widths are designed; row heights follow from them.

Your understanding: {"purpose":"展示部分A股个股的行情与行业归属，供读者快速查询和横向比较。","tasks":["按股票代码或名称定位个股，横向读取其价格、涨跌幅、成交额、市盈率和所属行业。","纵向比较个股的价格、涨跌幅、成交额及市盈率。","逐行浏览股票，了解行情与行业的对应关系。"],"relations":["代码和名称共同标识个股；同一行的行情指标与行业均属于该股票。","最新价、涨跌幅、成交额和市盈率是不同的比较指标；成交额表头中的“亿”是单位。"],"roles":["首行是列标题，应清楚标明指标和单位；后六行各代表一只股票。","代码列是行标题和主要定位依据，名称列提供另一种识别方式。","四个行情指标列支持纵向比较，所属行业列提供分类信息。"],"keep_whole":["六位股票代码。","价格、涨跌幅及其他数值中的连续数字和符号。","表头中的“亿”及其括号应作为单位整体阅读。"],"may_wrap":["股票名称和行业名称可按汉字自然换行，但应尽量减少拆分。","较长的成交额表头可以换行，单位宜保持完整。","市盈率中可在内容允许的断点处换行，仍需保持数值易于辨认。"],"same_scale":["代码、最新价和涨跌幅列都需要容纳完整的识别码或数值，应保持足够且相近的可用宽度。","名称和所属行业均为中文分类文字，可根据其查找作用和换行代价分配不同宽度。"],"h_vs_v":"完整单行显示所有内容超过视口；优先保证代码及关键行情数值完整，以中文名称、行业和长表头的适度换行换取无横向滚动的阅读，同时控制行高增长。"}
